newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen having little scope on upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen having little scope on upside.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30

Cocoa futures may struggle to vault over the stiff chart barrier at 1,000 stg a tonne basis September, and a retracement is on the cards in the slightly longer term, technical analysts said on Monday.
Traders called the market to open a couple of sterling higher.
On Friday, the New York cocoa futures ended moderately lower in somnolent trade, pressured by local and light speculative selling ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
Traders said strength in the U.S. dollar against the sterling and other European currencies sparked some light arbitrage selling.
The London market ended Friday with pared gains.
On the charts, analysts said cocoa's rebound from last week's low of 965 was far from impressive and the market could trend lower in the longer term.
"The rally is looking fairly unconvincing," said Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst.
Resistance starts at 1,000 stg, followed by 1,008 and 1,020.
On the downside, support reaches down to July 24's floor of 965.
"I suspect in the slightly longer term, it's going to come back lower, 950 no problem at all," she added.
The 14-day relative strength indicator was at 36 percent, just above the 30-value oversold indicator.
But the short- and medium-term moving averages were still above the 1,000 stg mark. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
